Full-colour photorealistic cinematic frames, consistent with the reference images: lilac #A99BFF cube room, glossy near-black and cream checkerboard floor, one neon-lime yellow #EEFE3A square. Panel 17: low side-profile shot at floor level: NEUS lying on her side at her end, cheek on the floor, pushing a deep violet bottle with one finger toward a black king in the centre; THE DOUBLE at the opposite end, kneeling, watching worried. Panel 18: side profile wide: the deep violet bottle knocks the black king over onto the neon-lime square with a burst of light, the bottle stays upright; at the opposite end THE DOUBLE smiles softly and fades, translucent; NEUS at her end, calm. Correct anatomy and hands, cohesive palette.
